subject.title: Isolated cron consistently fails with "LLM request failed" on model-call-started phase

question: Which cron recovery contract should own the remaining broad failures: watchdog setup-progress, fallback idle timeout, stuck-session reset/recovery, or a coordinated combined policy?
rationale: The source evidence supports multiple overlapping failure subpaths, and choosing timeout/recovery semantics affects existing cron behavior rather than being a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Settle Narrow Fixes Then Verify
options.body: Keep #91363 open, choose the canonical narrowed fixes for watchdog, fallback idle-timeout, and recovery behavior, and require live scheduled isolated-cron proof before closing the broad report.

options.title: Designate One Canonical Owner
options.body: Pick one canonical issue or PR to own all remaining cron failure behavior, then close or redirect the overlapping siblings only after that item has a mergeable proof path.

options.title: Accept Current Subcase Fix Only
options.body: Treat #94062 as sufficient for the exact `LLM request failed.` classifier path and defer the remaining watchdog/recovery symptoms to separately filed reports, accepting duplicate-user evidence risk.

recommendation.title: Settle Narrow Fixes Then Verify
recommendation.body: Keep #91363 open, choose the canonical narrowed fixes for watchdog, fallback idle-timeout, and recovery behavior, and require live scheduled isolated-cron proof before closing the broad report.

likelyOwner.reason: The open question spans cron gateway/tool ownership, model fallback, and scheduler behavior, and this history shows recent broad cron/gateway ownership work.
